subject.title: fix(reef): add timeout and bounded JSON reads to relay transport

question: Should all Reef relay REST operations adopt the proposed unconditional 15-second pre-header deadline, including self-hosted relays, or should the deadline align with Reef's existing 30-second WebSocket handshake budget?
rationale: The patch proves that a bounded deadline restores reconnect behavior, but source and tests cannot decide how much healthy relay latency the product should tolerate before failing closed.

options.title: Approve the 15-second deadline
options.body: Land the proven timeout as written and accept that slower relays will reconnect after 15 seconds.

options.title: Align to 30 seconds
options.body: Use Reef's existing WebSocket handshake budget to reduce upgrade breakage while still eliminating indefinite hangs.

recommendation.title: Approve the 15-second deadline
recommendation.body: Land the proven timeout as written and accept that slower relays will reconnect after 15 seconds.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently changed and proved the exact Reef relay request boundary on current main, making them the best available routing candidate for the timeout-policy review.
